findings_qualitative.value: Most dust emission (star formation) lies 48-65 kpc SW of the AGN in three components; CO(8-7) found at Loke ~90 kpc away with no continuum or optical counterpart.

evidence.quote: the vast majority of the 235 GHz dust emission originates from three components (Freja, Thor and Odin) aligned along a “string” shifted $48-65$ kpc towards the SW

claims.hypothesis: Is the star formation in MRC0943-242 associated with the AGN host?
claims.experiment: ALMA 235 GHz continuum plus SED decomposition
claims.result: Yggdrasil flux 0.8 mJy; Freja/Thor/Odin dominate, ~50% of IR luminosity
claims.finding: Most star formation is in companions 48-65 kpc from the AGN

evidence.quote: we apparently find that most of the star formation is not associated with the radio galaxy itself, but is in a companion set of galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Is there molecular gas offset from the AGN?
claims.experiment: CO(8-7) search in ALMA cube, ATCA CO(1-0) recheck
claims.result: 3.5 sigma CO(8-7) at Loke, 2.8 sigma CO(1-0)
claims.finding: Tentative low-excitation molecular reservoir at ~90 kpc

evidence.quote: The other 3.5$\sigma$ CO(8–7) detection is located $\sim90$ kpc SW of Yggdrasil

claims.hypothesis: Is there extended neutral absorbing gas?
claims.experiment: Voigt fits to Lyα absorption in MUSE
claims.result: Component 2 black core across Bifrost, N_HI ~1e19
claims.finding: Optically thick unity-covering absorber extends >60 kpc

evidence.quote: this thick, unity covering fraction absorber is extended, and visible in absorption out to $>60$ kpc.

why_this_data.value: Pilot study to combine ALMA and MUSE for spatially resolved gas phases of HzRGs

evidence.quote: This combination allows us to trace the spatially-resolved distributions of the ionisation state of the warm ionised medium

evidence.quote: We note that because the line is saturated, this estimate is very uncertain and likely a lower limit to the true value.
